folderHint: How folders will be named in Clicksign
contactFieldsDescription: This mapping is required when the signer of the signature group is the deal's "Default contact".
signAsHint: Field created during APP installation (do not delete)
facialBiometrics: Use facial biometrics as an additional authentication point for the signer
facialBiometricsHint: Additional cost of R$ 1.50 per facial biometrics successfully performed (charged by Clicksign).
handwritten: Use handwritten signature as an authentication point at the moment of signing
officialDocument: Request a photo (front and back) of the official document
rubrica: Request initials (requires enabling the envelope feature)
